run_func_benchmarks: run the FuncBenchmarks class to benchmark unary, binary, and layer functions in Crypten
run_model_benchmarks: run the ModelBenchmarks class to benchmark ML models with configurable epochs and advanced model flags
test_func_benchmark_data: test the function benchmark DataFrame for correct row count, runtime, and total absolute error columns
test_model_benchmark_data: test the model benchmark DataFrame for correct row count, seconds per epoch, inference time, and accuracy
test_advanced_model_benchmarks: test that ModelBenchmarks includes additional models when the advanced_models flag is set to True
